text: Q: X is widely regarded alongside Aristotle and Gottlob Frege, as one of the most significant logicians in history. His work in mathematics and mathematical logic is considered pioneering to these fields. Amongst other things, X developed a numbering technique, now known as X numbering, which codes formal expressions as natural numbers. While X is well renowned in the field of mathematics, he is also well known in the fields of American political and legal science. Who is X, and why is he of interest to American political and legal academics? ‎
